  "problem": "Design a minimal REST API for task management.",
  "objectives": [
    "Define a minimal set of endpoints for basic task operations.",
    "Specify the HTTP methods and URL structures.",
    "Outline the expected request/response formats.",
    "Keep the design simple and focused on core CRUD functionality."
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "The API must be RESTful.",
    "It should be minimal, avoiding unnecessary complexity.",
    "Use standard HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) appropriately.",
    "Responses should follow a consistent JSON structure."
  ],
  "non_goals": [
    "Implement advanced features like authentication, pagination, or filtering.",
    "Define a backend technology stack or database schema.",
    "Specify deployment or hosting details."
  ],
  "open_questions": [
    "What specific fields should a 'task' object contain (e.g., id, title, description, status)?",
    "Should there be an endpoint for listing all tasks or just individual task operations?",
    "Is versioning (e.g., /v1/) required for the API?",
    "Should error responses follow a specific format (e.g., {error: message})?"
  ],
  "raw_prompt": "Diseña una API REST minimal para gestionar tareas. Responde con estructura JSON."
}
